description: Fetch gnomAD variant data for an Ensembl transcript (ENST…), returning transcript coordinates, gene symbol, chromosome position, and per-variant allele counts (ac/an) from exome and genome datasets. Variants are paged (default 500, max 2,000 per call); variants_page gives the exact total and next_offset.

limit.description: Variants to return, 1-2000. Default 500. gnomAD returns every variant with no limit of its own (BRCA1 has ~7,300), so the list is paged here; variants_page says how many exist and the next offset.

offset.description: Skip this many variants first, for the next page (variants_page.next_offset). Default 0.

name: transcript
